Package neqsim.process.equipment.powergeneration.gasturbine

Class GasTurbinePerformanceMap

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.powergeneration.gasturbine.GasTurbinePerformanceMap
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GasTurbinePerformanceMap extends Object implements Serializable
Part-load and ambient-correction performance map for a gas turbine.

The map combines three effects to map ISO rated performance from GasTurbineSpec to actual site conditions and operating load:

  • Part-load heat rate — polynomial in load fraction (load = actual power / rated power at site conditions). Default coefficients reproduce the classical aeroderivative shape: ~+5 % heat rate at 75 % load, ~+18 % at 50 %, ~+45 % at 30 %.
  • Ambient temperature correction — linear loss of available power above 15 °C ISO (~0.7 %/°C for aeroderivatives, ~0.5 %/°C for industrial frames) and a small heat-rate penalty.
  • Site pressure / altitude correction — power scales linearly with ambient pressure ratio relative to 1.013 bara.

All coefficients can be overridden if vendor maps are available.

    • getSitePowerFactor

      public double getSitePowerFactor(double ambientTemperatureK)
      Temperature-only site-rating factor: available power at the ambient temperature divided by the ISO rated power (no site pressure correction). Uses the vendor table from setSiteRatingTable(double[], double[]) when set (linear interpolation, end-slope extrapolation), else the linear 1 - powerLossPerKelvin (T - 15 C) lapse. The factor is floored at 0.5 for the linear lapse and at 0.05 for a vendor table.
      Parameters:
      ambientTemperatureK - ambient temperature [K]
      Returns:
      available power fraction of the ISO rating (1.0 at 15 C)

    • setSiteRatingTable

      public void setSiteRatingTable(double[] ambientK, double[] powerFactor)
      Install a vendor site-rating table (available power versus ambient temperature). Replaces the linear lapse of setAmbientCorrection(double, double) for power.
      Parameters:
      ambientK - ambient temperatures [K], strictly ascending, at least two points
      powerFactor - available power as a fraction of the ISO rated power at each ambient temperature
      Throws:

    • setExhaustTemperatureRisePerKelvin

      public void setExhaustTemperatureRisePerKelvin(double risePerKelvin)
      Set the full-load exhaust temperature sensitivity to ambient temperature (used when no vendor exhaust table is set). A gas turbine at constant firing temperature has lower air mass flow on a hot day, so the exhaust gets hotter.
      Parameters:
      risePerKelvin - exhaust temperature rise per kelvin of ambient temperature [K/K], typically 0.3 to 0.8
